name: Lyria 3
description: Generate a complete 30-second song from a text prompt, with vocals and either supplied or model-written lyrics. Length, BPM, and structure are prompt-driven via timestamp ranges and [Verse]/[Chorus] section tags; there is no duration, seed, or negative-prompt parameter. Returns 44.1 kHz MP3 carrying an embedded SynthID watermark. Google model code lyria-3-clip-preview (Preview).
